decisions.q: Rank run shape roles half a point below build roles with the same fit?
decisions.why: Build shape roles got a call 14 of 45 times (31%), run shape 3 of 14 (21%). Too small a gap to act on yet.

decisions.q: Send a note to a named person with every application at 8 or more?
decisions.why: With a note: 7 calls from 23 (30%). Without: 12 from 45 (27%). Too small a gap to act on yet.

decisions.q: Apply cold to companies over 500 people only when the role is build shape?
decisions.why: Under 150 people: 9 calls from 22 (41%). Over 500: 5 from 25 (20%).
decisions.answer: Yes. Run shape roles at 500+ people are now listed for reference only.

decisions.q: Treat 21 days of silence as closed and stop follow ups there?
decisions.why: 15 applications have had no human reply after 21 days.
